title: Badge PIN reset
text: Open the badge app and choose Reset PIN. The new PIN arrives by text message within five minutes. A badge locks after three wrong PIN attempts. Reception can unlock it once you show photo ID. Lost badges are blocked as soon as you report them in the app. A replacement badge is ready at reception the next working day.

title: Printer setup
text: Add printers from the Self Service app, not from system settings. The app installs the right driver and the badge release queue. Colour printing is off by default for every account. Ask your manager to approve colour in the service portal. Print jobs wait in the queue for twelve hours. Jobs that nobody releases are deleted after that.

title: Laptop encryption
text: Disk encryption turns on automatically at the first sign-in. The first encryption pass can take up to two hours. Keep the laptop plugged in while encryption runs. Closing the lid pauses it until the next start. The recovery key is stored in your device record. Only the service desk can read it after checking your identity.

title: VPN access
text: Install the VPN client from Self Service and sign in with your work account. The client connects on its own whenever you leave the office network. Split tunnelling sends video calls outside the VPN. Everything else goes through the company network. VPN sessions end after ten hours. Sign in again to start a new session.

title: Shared mailboxes
text: Request a shared mailbox through the service portal and name two owners. The owners approve every new member from then on. Messages sent from a shared mailbox show its name, not yours. Sent copies are stored in the shared mailbox, not in your own. Shared mailboxes have a 50 GB quota. Owners get a warning email at 45 GB.

title: Software requests
text: Request software that is not in Self Service through the service portal. Security reviews the request within three working days. Free trials still need a request. Trials that skip the review are removed during the weekly scan. Browser extensions come from the approved list only. Other extensions are switched off at the next policy refresh.

title: Phone setup
text: Enrol a work phone by scanning the code on the setup page. Email and the chat app install themselves afterwards. A phone that is not updated for 30 days loses access to email. Access comes back as soon as the update is installed. Report a lost phone in the service portal so it can be wiped. Personal photos on an enrolled personal phone are not touched by the wipe.

title: Password changes
text: Change your password at the self-service password page. The new password reaches every system within fifteen minutes. Passwords expire every 180 days. You get reminder emails during the last two weeks. The last ten passwords cannot be reused. A password from a known leak list is rejected straight away.

title: Video conferencing rooms
text: Book a video room in the calendar and add the room as a guest. The room screen shows the meeting five minutes before it starts. Press the green button on the table panel to join. The camera turns on only after you press the camera icon. Rooms that nobody checks into are released after ten minutes. Released rooms can then be booked by anyone.

title: File sharing
text: Share files from the company drive with a link, not as attachments. Links to people outside the company expire after 30 days. Folders marked confidential cannot be shared outside the company. The share button stays grey for them. Deleted files stay in the drive bin for 60 days. After that only the service desk can restore them, within another 30 days.

title: Monitor and dock issues
text: If a second monitor stays black, unplug the dock for ten seconds. Most screens come back after the dock restarts. Docks need the firmware pushed every quarter. The update runs overnight while the laptop is connected. Report a faulty dock in the service portal. A swap is left at reception within two working days.

title: New starter accounts
text: Managers request accounts for new starters at least five working days before day one. Late requests are handled the same day only for urgent cases. The new starter gets a temporary password by text on day one. It must be changed at the first sign-in. Access to finance systems needs a separate request. The finance owner approves it within two working days.
